'''Alsakan Crossing''' was the name given to a pair of bridges that linked the northeastern corner of the [[Alsakan Lowlands]] to the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The bridge spanned the [[Fornaak River]], and was located at the western base of [[Mount Tessef]].
